about: Who may have a pull-request run signed with the CI key. Read from the BASE commit of the pull request, so a pull request cannot widen it. 'logins' are GitHub accounts (checked for whoever opened the pull request and whoever triggered the run; GitHub authenticates these). 'emails' are fnmatch patterns for commit author emails (git author fields are free text, so they only catch a stray commit by someone else). Forks are refused before this list is read.
